document_kinds.index: Deterministic physical navigation; never owns project claims.
document_kinds.subsystem: A major independently owned part of a system.
document_kinds.component: A stable architectural unit with a distinct responsibility.
document_kinds.capability: A durable system ability spanning one or more units.
document_kinds.interface: An API, command, event, port, protocol, or integration boundary.
document_kinds.data: A durable information model or data-ownership boundary.
document_kinds.policy: A durable rule governing system behavior.
document_kinds.deployment: A runtime, delivery, or operational topology boundary.
document_kinds.concept: A stable architectural concept that does not fit a narrower core kind.

INV.meaning: Truth that holds across all valid states and transitions.

OBS.meaning: Confirmed architecture-significant repository evidence; not intent.

OQ.meaning: Unresolved choice; it blocks reconstruction only when listed in manifest blockers.

relations.contains: Source contains the target architectural concept.
relations.decomposes-into: Source is decomposed into the target.
relations.consumes: Source consumes the target interface or event.
relations.publishes: Source publishes the target event or contract.
relations.reads-from: Source reads data from the target.
relations.writes-to: Source writes data to the target.
relations.constrained-by: Source is constrained by the target claim or owner.
relations.implemented-by: Source intent is currently implemented by the target evidence.
relations.has-evidence: Source claim has the target evidence.
relations.superseded-by: Source identity or claim is replaced by the target.
relations.related-to: Source has a durable relationship for which no narrower relation applies.
relations.refines: Source adds detail to the target.
relations.satisfies: Source satisfies the target requirement or constraint.
relations.verified-by: Source is verified by the target.
relations.specified-by: Source is specified by the target contract or owner.
relations.compatible-with: Source is declared compatible with the target.
relations.migrates-from: Source is the migration successor of the target.

facets.interfaces: APIs, commands, events, ports, protocols, and contracts.
facets.data: Information models, ownership, mutation, and consistency.
facets.failure: Errors, retry, degradation, compensation, and recovery.

facet_values.complete: The owner declares the facet sufficiently specified.
facet_values.partial: Some durable information is present but a known completeness gap remains.
facet_values.not-applicable: The facet has been reviewed and does not apply.

inspection_modes.refresh: Refresh against a newer evidence baseline.
inspection_modes.exhaustive: Exhaustive inspection of the declared scope.

inspection_facet_values.checked: The facet was inspected at the recorded baseline.
inspection_facet_values.not-checked: No current comparison claim is made for the facet.

implementation_freedom.contract-equivalent: Any internals satisfying normative contracts are permitted.
implementation_freedom.architecture-constrained: Specified component boundaries and interactions are also required.
implementation_freedom.exact: Choices explicitly declared exact are required.

computed_statuses.blocked: At least one manifest blocker is present.
computed_statuses.ready: No blocker exists and every facet is complete or not-applicable.
computed_statuses.incomplete: The area is neither blocked nor ready.

asset_roles.execution-contract: Exact reconstruction-critical toolchain or execution contract.

heading_meanings.boundaries: What is inside, outside, or owned elsewhere.
heading_meanings.interfaces: APIs, commands, events, ports, protocols, and exact contract links.
heading_meanings.data-ownership: Creation, mutation, reading, and consistency authority.
heading_meanings.failure-behavior: Errors, retry, degradation, compensation, and recovery.
heading_meanings.configuration-contract: Settings, defaults, precedence, validation, and reload behavior.
heading_meanings.relationships: Typed directed links to other canonical owners or claims.
heading_meanings.invariants: Truths across all valid states and transitions.
heading_meanings.known-divergences: Confirmed conflicts between accepted intent and observations.
heading_meanings.rationale-and-trade-offs: Reasons and consequences behind accepted choices.
heading_meanings.terminology: Project-specific domain terms and exact meanings.

manifest_fields.specspine: Stored format major; exactly 3 for this contract.
manifest_fields.implementation_freedom: How closely a reconstruction must preserve implementation choices.
manifest_fields.areas: Completeness and inspection records for non-index document owners.
manifest_fields.assets: Complete registry of non-Markdown files inside the Spine.
manifest_fields.presentation: Optional language, heading, order, and index rendering profile.
manifest_fields.facets: Completeness or inspection values by architectural facet.
manifest_fields.inspection: Repository comparison coverage at one evidence baseline.
manifest_fields.source: Identifier of the inspected repository state.
manifest_fields.role: Semantic role of a registered asset.
manifest_fields.normative: Whether conformance depends on the asset.
manifest_fields.verifies: VER identifiers verified by the asset.
manifest_fields.headings: Localized renderings keyed by canonical section key.
manifest_fields.section_order: Every canonical section key exactly once in rendering order.
manifest_fields.root-title: Root index H1 template containing {project} exactly once.
manifest_fields.purpose: Portable explanation of what SpecSpine is.
manifest_fields.scope: Portable explanation of what the Spine directory contains.
manifest_fields.guide-heading: Rendered heading for root-index reading instructions.
manifest_fields.guide: Compact portable reading and authority instructions.
manifest_fields.glossary-heading: Rendered heading for the complete concise vocabulary.
manifest_fields.glossary: Complete concise localized vocabulary; it must preserve token coverage.
manifest_fields.contents-heading: Rendered heading for deterministic physical contents.
manifest_fields.nested-heading: Rendered heading for nested independent Spine roots.
manifest_fields.empty: Rendered text used when an index has no entries.

markdown_keywords.Aliases: Optional alternate names for retrieval; never alternate identities.
markdown_keywords.Summary: Required single-line document description rendered in deterministic indexes.
markdown_keywords.Evidence: Repository-relative paths supporting an OBS statement.
markdown_keywords.Target: Relative link to the relationship target.
markdown_keywords.Meaning: Nonempty explanation of why a relationship applies.
markdown_keywords.Intended: Normative semantic ID in a known-divergence row.
markdown_keywords.Observed: Conflicting OBS semantic ID in a known-divergence row.
markdown_keywords.Consequence: Architectural or user-visible impact of a divergence.
markdown_keywords.SHOULD: Recommended normative choice; deviation requires an explicit reason.
markdown_keywords.SHOULD NOT: Normally prohibited choice; deviation requires an explicit reason.
